issues.description: Console error: 'Failed to fetch RSC payload for http://localhost:3000/. Falling back to browser navigation.' This indicates a server instability or RSC streaming issue during Fast Refresh, causing potential hydration failures.
issues.root_cause: Fast Refresh triggered a server-side RSC re-fetch that failed, likely due to a momentary server restart or compilation error during hot reload. Could be caused by a server component that throws during re-render, or a missing/incorrect export in apps/web/app/page.tsx or its layout.

issues.description: Console warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative, fixed, or absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' This warning appears 3 times, indicating a scroll-related component (likely a parallax or scroll progress component) has a statically-positioned parent container.
issues.root_cause: A component using a scroll library (likely framer-motion useScroll or react-scroll) references a container ref whose CSS position is 'static' (default). The hero section or its wrapper in apps/web/app/page.tsx or a hero component file lacks position: relative.

issues.description: Background image appears darker than expected — the dark overlay may be too opaque, partially obscuring the hero room photo. The expected behavior specifies the hero image should be 'visible'.
issues.root_cause: The hero section likely has an overlay div with high opacity (e.g. bg-black/60 or similar Tailwind class) or the background image itself has low contrast due to CSS filter or opacity settings in the hero component.

issues.description: The background color specification is #091829 (dark navy), but the visible background appears more charcoal/dark gray rather than a distinct navy blue. This could be correct given the dark overlay on the image, but should be verified.
issues.root_cause: The root layout or page wrapper in apps/web/app/layout.tsx or apps/web/app/page.tsx may not have the correct background color set as #091829.

fixes.reason: Adding 'relative' positioning to the hero section container fixes the scroll offset warning by ensuring scroll libraries can correctly calculate offsets relative to this container.
Ensures the dark navy background color #091829 is applied to the body as specified in expected behavior, visible before/between content loads.
